Desensitization properties of 20 gain-of-function GABRB3 variant receptors were evaluated using two-electrode voltage-clamp electrophysiology.
Selected variants with increased or reduced desensitization were also evaluated using whole-cell electrophysiology in transfected mammalian cell lines.
Of the 20 gain-of-function variants assessed, 13 were found to alter receptor desensitization properties.
Seven variants reduced desensitization at equilibrium, which acts to worsen gain-of-function traits.
